# Chromecast receiver (`eyevinn-cast-receiver`)

A basic custom chromecast receiver that can be configured using environment variables. Add your company branding to your own chromecast receiver without writing a single line of code!

[Service documentation](https://github.com/Eyevinn/cast-receiver) · [Source](https://github.com/Eyevinn/cast-receiver)

## Example

```terraform
resource "osc_instance" "example" {
  service_id = "eyevinn-cast-receiver"
  name       = "myreceiver"

  parameters = {
    title                = "..."
    # castReceiverOptions  = "..."
    # playbackLogoUrl      = "..."
    # logoUrl              = "..."
    # castMediaPlayerStyle = "..."
  }
}
```

Commented lines are optional parameters. Values marked `"..."` need a real value. Outputs are `url`, `external_ip`, `external_port` and the raw `instance` document, see the `osc_instance` resource.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `title` | string | yes |  |
| `castReceiverOptions` | string | no |  |
| `playbackLogoUrl` | string | no |  |
| `logoUrl` | string | no |  |
| `castMediaPlayerStyle` | string | no |  |

Parameter values are strings; booleans take `"true"` or `"false"`. Reference an `osc_secret` as `osc_secret.<name>.ref` to keep a value out of the instance configuration. This page is generated from the OSC catalog; the provider validates against the live catalog when planning.
